Here is a non-disclosure agreement:
<<<
Non-Disclosure Agreement
Date:
Parties: [NAME OF INDIVIDUAL RECEIVING INFORMATION] of [address of individual] and FRODSHAM TOWN COUNCIL whose registered office is at CASTLE PARK HOUSE, CASTLE PARK, FRODSHAM, WA6 6SB (the Discloser)
1. The Discloser intends to disclose information (the Confidential Information) to the Recipient for the purpose of recommendation of future land use of the decommissioned play area on Ship Street (the Purpose).
2. The Recipient undertakes not to use the Confidential Information for any purpose except the Purpose, without first obtaining the written agreement of the Discloser.
3. The Recipient undertakes to keep the Confidential Information secure and not to disclose it to any third party.
4. The undertakings in clauses 2 and 3 above apply to all of the information disclosed by the Discloser to the Recipient, regardless of the way or form in which it is disclosed or recorded but they do not apply to:
a) any information which is or in future comes into the public domain (unless as a result of the breach of this Agreement); or
b) any information which is already known to the Recipient and which was not subject to any obligation of confidence before it was disclosed to the Recipient by the Discloser.
5. Nothing in this Agreement will prevent the Recipient from making any disclosure of the Confidential Information required by law or by any competent authority.
6. The Recipient will, on request from the Discloser, return all copies and records of the Confidential Information to the Discloser and will not retain any copies or records of the Confidential Information.
7. Neither this Agreement nor the supply of any information grants the Recipient any licence, interest or right in respect of any intellectual property rights of the Discloser except the right to copy the Confidential Information solely for the Purpose.
8. The undertakings in clauses 2 and 3 will continue in force indefinitely.
9. This Agreement is governed by, and is to be construed in accordance with, English law. The English Courts will have non-exclusive jurisdiction to deal with any dispute which has arisen or may arise out of, or in connection with, this Agreement.
Signed and Delivered as a Deed by:
[name of Recipient] in the presence of:
_____________________________
Signature
_____________________________
Signature of witness
_____________________________
Name of witness
>>>

Entailment / Contradiction / NotMentioned and quote the clause(s) of the agreement that decide it.

process: Identification of Confidential Information by the Discloser under the Non-Disclosure Agreement.

result:
Discloser's assertion (designation) of confidentiality — the discloser’s decision/intention to treat specified information as Confidential Information under the NDA.
(the sketch behind this choice: Candidate A — Discloser's assertion of confidentiality (intent to protect): develops into express designation in the NDA, marking rules, scope definitions, handling procedures and provenance statements; opposite = implied/public disclosure or deliberate non-assertion; contradiction = need for affirmative identification vs cases where nothing is asserted; resolution = express-designation rules plus objective/default criteria (trade-secret tests, contextual presumptions).

Candidate B — Internal classification/taxonomy: develops into templates, tiered protection, metadata and automated ID; opposite = ad hoc/contextual identification (oral, situational disclosures); contradiction = rigid taxonomy excludes edge cases and tacit data; resolution = hybrid system: classification + exception protocols and fallback clauses.

Candidate C — Marking/labeling practice: develops into stamps, legends, machine-readable metadata and machine enforcement; opposite = unmarked/confidential-by-circumstance information (tacit knowledge, oral disclosure); contradiction = marks cannot capture unmarked confidentiality; resolution = require accompanying assertion or contractual fallbacks that convert circumstance into designated confidentiality.)
carry: You asked for the root process underlying 'Identification of Confidential Information by the Discloser under the NDA.' I compared three candidates (assertion of confidentiality; internal classification; and marking), traced how each develops into identification, identified their opposites, contradictions and resolutions. The clearest, most generative root is the Discloser’s assertion (decision) to treat particular information as Confidential Information under the NDA.

result: resolution (replacement): Replace the binary by treating Confidential status as a single, constitutive process—a "Constitutive Disclosure Determination" (CDD). The CDD is not merely an assertion or only an internal appraisal; it is a single enacted adjudication in which evaluative attention to content (sensitivity appraisal) and the declarative move (labeling/marking) become inseparable moments of one performative act that creates Confidential status. In a CDD, an information item is identified as Confidential only when the appraisal-informed articulation is performed and recorded as a determinate disclosure act; appraisal without that enactment remains a latent sensitivity judgment, and naked assertion without that evidentiary articulation is a provisional speech act that becomes binding only insofar as it participates in the CDD. Sensitivity appraisal supplies the evidentiary work and thresholds that shape the determination; the declarative element is the performative move that instantiates and records the determination. Neither alone constitutes Confidential status within this view; only their fused execution as the CDD produces determinate confidentiality. This both honors the informational content (risk/value) and the social/contractual act (declaration/marking) by folding them into one ontological production of confidentiality, eliminating the paradox of two independent instantiations.

designations.justification: An element of the simplest's development: Sensitivity appraisal — an internal evaluative process by which properties of the information (risk, competitive value, secrecy) are discerned from the content itself. -> Boundary specification — explicit delineation of content segments and attributes treated as potentially confidential -> Nominative designation — the discloser’s assignment of the NDA Confidential label to identified items
designations.independence: Sensitivity appraisal is a content‑driven evaluative process that can be executed by recipients, auditors, automated classifiers, or regulators without any prior or concurrent act of the discloser. The appraisal can generate delimitations and labels (and even an authoritative non‑confidential judgment or external confidentiality regime) that make a discloser’s own assertion unnecessary or moot; thus its development does not rely on the discloser’s assertion and can exclude the need for that assertion without destroying the concept of such an assertion.

contradictions.unity_justification: The contradiction is between the Discloser’s assertion (an explicit declarative decision to label information Confidential under the NDA) and Sensitivity appraisal (an internal, content-driven evaluation of risk/value): they are portrayed as mutually constitutive developmentally, yet either can instantiate confidential status independently—declaration without substantive appraisal, or appraisal without any formal declarative act.
contradictions.developing_unity_description: The two poles interlock through a bundle of converging strands—boundary specification, nominative designation, and declarative commitment—that can be reached via multiple pathways: (a) Sensitivity appraisal -> Boundary specification -> Nominative designation -> Declarative commitment; (b) Comparative valuation -> Contextual thresholding -> Discloser’s affirmative identification; (c) Declarative commitment -> Sensitivity appraisal -> Declarative loop. These parallel, looping pathways form a unity because they converge on identification of Confidential Information even while the causal direction and necessity differ (one path can operate without the other).

resolution_relations.how_resolves: It takes both sides into its own development by making appraisal and assertion sequential, dependent facets of a single constitutive move rather than independent routes to the same status. Sensitivity appraisal supplies the evidentiary work and thresholds that shape the determination; the declarative element is the performative move that instantiates and records the determination. Neither alone constitutes Confidential status within this view; only their fused execution as the CDD produces determinate confidentiality. This both honors the informational content (risk/value) and the social/contractual act (declaration/marking) by folding them into one ontological production of confidentiality, eliminating the paradox of two independent instantiations.
